(Excerpt: licence header of src/external/libcrux_mlkem768_sha3.c at commit ee5627aaf630fc0c304b12757e6654773f4c1033. MIT. Bundled ML-KEM fallback; only used when the crypto backend lacks ML-KEM (with the OpenSSL backend at OpenSSL >= 3.5, mlkem_crypto.c is used instead), so it may not be linked.)
